title: ide, oda, honnan, onnan: Here and There

sections.title: The itt/ott family, completed
sections.content: You already know itt ("here") and ott ("there") for plain location. ide ("to here") and oda ("to there") are their destination partners; onnan ("from there") and honnan ("from where") complete the set the same way -hoz/-hez/-höz and -tól/-től complete -nál/-nél.

sections.title: At / To / From, for here and there

sections.content: These sit in front of the verb as their own word, not glued on — Ide jövök and Oda megyek keep ide/oda separate, the same way you already write nagyon szeretem as two words.
